Spider of the Week 6 - Argyroneta Aquatica (Water-Spider / Diving Bell Spider)

The diving bell spider is a neat little guy that builds it home underwater making a "diving bell" out of fine silk, it then fills this home with air it brings down trapped in the hairs on its body, young spiders are known to use empty shells and other similar structures before making their own nest. It will spend the majority of its life underwater and they are great swimmers and underwater hunters.
